paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: The distribution of datasets over time for the five most studied and all other languages combined. English has received most of the attention which has risen over time, while research on other languages became prominent after 2017.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets available for different languages over the years from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, ordered chronologically from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and uses an exponential scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2. Each year features stacked bars that represent datasets for various languages. The colors of the bars correspond to different languages as indicated by the legend: blue for English, orange for "All other" languages, green for Arabic, red for Bengali, purple for Spanish, and brown for Russian. From 2012 to 2015, only "English" had at least one dataset. In 2016, "English" had 10 datasets, and "All Other" had datasets ranging from 1 to 10. In 2017, for example, the tallest segment is for English, followed by "All other" languages, both of which reach between 10^1 and 10^2. In contrast, Bengali has consistently shorter segments across the years. Between 2017 and 2021, we observed a steady increase in the number of datasets. Bars are arranged in no specific sorting order except that chronology is applied to the bars, and there is no visual emphasis on bars except for 2022, where bars are shaded lighter. A legend is available on the top left of the plot to map different bar colors to their labels.
